name: eitri
description: Hardware design with checks that run on every build, all on your computer: the combined multi-domain workspace (a whole machine: structure, mechanism, wiring, firmware, air and its circuit checked together) and six single domains (CAD, wire harnesses, mechanisms, pneumatics, firmware, electronics). Every check's number cites its source. No account or API key; two anonymous counts (install, project created), off with `eitri telemetry off`.
